metadata.question: Did the town of Marovoay have higher water extent in January 27, 2020 than January 18, 2017?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about water extent in Marovoay, Madagascar on two specific dates: January 27, 2020 vs January 18, 2017. 1. Search strategy: - Location: Marovoay, Madagascar (need to define geometry) - Dates: January 27, 2020 and January 18, 2017 - Data: Sentinel-2 would be good for water detection with NDWI - Need to handle potential cloud cover 2. Masking strategy: - Use Sentinel-2 cloud masking - Calculate NDWI (Normalized Difference Water Index) for water detection - Threshold NDWI to identify water pixels 3. Logic: - Get images for both dates - Check if collections have data - Calculate water extent (count of water pixels) - Compare the two values - Validate results are reasonable (not null/NaN, within expected range) Approach: - Use Sentinel-2 MSI - Define Marovoay area (using a point buffer or known coordinates) - Filter by dates ±1 day to account for potential missing data - Calculate NDWI = (Green - NIR)/(Green + NIR) - Threshold NDWI > 0 to identify water - Count water pixels for each date - Compare counts ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const marovoay = ee.Geometry.Point([46.6347, -16.1110]).buffer(5000); // 5km buffer around Marovoay // Date ranges (±1 day to account for potential missing data) const date2017 = ['2017-01-17', '2017-01-19']; const date2020 = ['2020-01-26', '2020-01-28']; // 2. Data Acquisition function getWaterCollection(dateRange) { return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(marovoay) .filterDate(dateRange[0], dateRange[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); } const col2017 = getWaterCollection(date2017); const col2020 = getWaterCollection(date2020); // Check collection sizes const size2017 = col2017.size().getInfo(); const size2020 = col2020.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2017 Images: ${size2017}, 2020 Images: ${size2020}`); if (size2017 === 0 || size2020 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get first (closest) image for each date const img2017 = col2017.first(); const img2020 = col2020.first(); // Function to calculate water extent function calculateWaterExtent(img) { // Calculate NDWI const ndwi = img.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B8']).rename('NDWI'); // Create water mask (NDWI > 0 indicates water) const waterMask = ndwi.gt(0); // Count water pixels const waterCount = waterMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: marovoay, scale: 20, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDWI'); return waterCount; } const water2017 = calculateWaterExtent(img2017).getInfo(); const water2020 = calculateWaterExtent(img2020).getInfo(); console.log(`Water pixels 2017: ${water2017}, 2020: ${water2020}`); // Validation checks if (water2017 === null || water2020 === null || isNaN(water2017) || isNaN(water2020) || water2017 < 0 || water2020 < 0) { console.log("C3"); return; } if (water2017 === 0 || water2020 === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Final comparison if (water2020 > water2017) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
